title: RPLIDAR A2M8 never streams scans with the new ROS 2 driver
platform: Slamtec RPLIDAR A2M8 on serial/USB, NVIDIA Jetson (Ubuntu 24.04, JetPack 7.2), ROS 2 Lyrical with the rplidar_driver package (lifecycle node)
symptom: With the older rplidar_ros package the lidar starts and streams scans, but with the newer rplidar_driver package the same lidar never produces data: the node reports it as a legacy device, raises a health error and disconnects. The reporter posted both launch outputs for comparison.
provenance: Log copied from the public issue thread (machine output posted by the reporter). Not synthetic. Used in sealed evaluation batch 1, so it is no longer a blind test case.
